record.title: Microduck shin plate — the 'leg' body of Pollen's MJCF: 20 x 58 mm, 2.3/2.8 mm plate with a 12.4 mm rib, XL330 horn disc at the knee, Ø10 boss for the 15x10x3 ankle bearing
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid (bin/cad part:microduck-shin, 2026-09-01) and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen's own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/leg.stl: p95 surface distance 1.00 mm both ways, median 0.001 mm, bbox delta 0.00 mm, 20/20 holes and bosses matched. The report is the ledger artifact.
record.origin_why: modelled by hand in cecad from measurements taken off Pollen Robotics' decimated visual mesh (CC BY-SA-NC sim asset) with cad-mjcf sections and cecad.meshfeatures; nobody has Pollen's CAD and no physical part has been measured. Admitted through the TRIAD.md door: evidence/ledger.jsonl + computed trust.json.
record.why_this_folder_exists: Each shin of the Microduck is this plate (the MJCF places `leg` once per side as a visual geom plus a self-collision copy of the same geom — 2 per robot, not 4; measured.json's `placed` counted the collision copies). Nothing on the shelf is a 42 mm XL330-horn-to-bearing link.
